name: General Code Quality Analysis
checks: Architecture and design pattern choices — are they appropriate for the problem?
Code quality: readability, complexity, duplication, naming conventions
Security: hardcoded secrets, injection risks, unsafe dependencies
Test coverage: are tests present, meaningful, and well-structured?
Documentation: README completeness, inline comments, API docs
Dependency hygiene: outdated packages, unused dependencies, known CVEs
Error handling: are errors caught, logged, and surfaced correctly?
Performance: obvious bottlenecks, N+1 queries, unnecessary allocations
